public_rationale: The classical-planning example holds: the 2023 optimal-track winner used a portfolio of search methods. But the robotics and image-interpretation examples are too broad. Contemporary papers identify a leading transformer-based robot policy and transformer-based visual models with strong benchmark results. The record supports continued importance of other methods, while contradicting little-to-no transformer use in these important examples. It does not establish adoption rates across every named field.
limitations: The result assesses named examples, not a numerical interpretation of many.
A leading system in one task does not characterize an entire field.
The planner abstract contains retrospective additions; the official competition announcement establishes the historical result.

statement.excerpt: It’s worth noting that for many different AI tasks --- robotics, image interpretation, planning, game playing, scientific applications, many forms of reasoning --- state of the art AI currently makes little to no use of the transformer architecture that underpins LLMs.
statement.document_title: Reports of the birth of AGI are greatly exaggerated

from_speaker: robotics, image interpretation, planning, game playing, scientific applications, many forms of reasoning
currently makes little to no use
our_interpretation: Little to no use means transformers are absent or peripheral in leading systems for the named task areas.
Transformer architecture includes vision transformers and transformer components inside hybrid systems, not only language models.
The named areas are examples to assess separately; the claim does not say every leading system in every area avoids transformers.
Current refers to the 2023 state of the art through October 18. This current-year window accommodates the public evaluations available before the post.
criteria.support_condition: Architecture descriptions show leading systems in several named areas achieving their results without material transformer components. Such evidence can support individual areas without establishing all of them.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Transformer components play central roles in leading systems across the named areas. A central transformer in a leading system contradicts the characterization for that example, without proving universal transformer adoption.
